conditions: "Aisha Khan" must resolve to a specific Slack user whose name is exactly "Aisha Khan" (not a similar name, and not someone whose display name/title merely includes those words).
The target must be an "incident channel" — a channel recognizable as being for incident response/management.
The channel's topic field must mention "postmortems" (the word itself or a clear reference to postmortems).
The channel must not currently be archived.
The phrasing assumes exactly one channel satisfies the incident/topic/archival conditions; the assistant invites Aisha Khan to that single channel.
